title: Set up the plugin test layout
detail: One package per plugin under plugins/, tests beside each.
result: Each plugin is a package under plugins/<name>/ with tests in plugins/<name>/tests/. Run one with: python3 -m pytest -q plugins/<name>. The tests are the contract and must not be edited.
